method: JLZ v12-R realized response injection and requested energy budget
entry: Freeze own Wentry/Hentry, raw A=15000*C0+H, positive finite canonical full-block subject anchors a_lr, native entry KLteacher. C0 native FP32 count division then FP64; H native CPUFP32 semantics. Recreate each next batch; no model reset inside trajectory.

builder.flow: For ascending eligible l: actual candidate lower weights act ALL tokens -> current native row subject keys including KL -> rewrite-only nested mean Kbar -> P=solve(A+KbarKbar.T,Kbar) over wholeB -> U=R P.T -> Wcand=Wentry+castFP32(U) -> actual effective v=(Wcand-Wentry)k for each rewrite/KL row -> continue actual ALL-token candidate boundary.
builder.first_layer_reuse: Only first eligible-layer keys/P independent of R may be cached within batch.
builder.response: M=P.T Krow; v effectiveFP32, R M idealFP64 tracked separately.

subject.injection: add each actual effective v_lj at native subject full-block output
subject.native_rows: All native rewrite/context rows and KL1; preserve NLL reductions and full-vocabulary current||entry KL
subject.cross_layer_graph: Keep lower subject injection->upper subject hidden->loss graph
subject.forward_losses: all F_r every candidate, no extra stop witness forward
subject.norm: beta_r=.5/(a_star_r²), sum_l beta_r||R_lr||, analytic gradient once; zero block gradient0

pullback.production: Lambda_l M_l.T in FP64, active-loss mask from clarification, then per-request norm gradient once.
pullback.included: M off-diagonal request coupling and subject cross-layer dependency
pullback.excluded: dK/dP, builder.reverse, full actual-lower->upper builder derivative, routes.cached_vjp/R4a, old v12 writer.apply
pullback.diagnostic_only: V14 reverse/same-layer/full causal reference with same loss mask

optimizer.state: per-request m,v,per-layer mean-square EMA s,t; bias correction by that request actual update count
optimizer.forbidden: No lr/a_star, eps*a_star, q-Adam, BB, warmup, price matching or per-layer masking.
optimizer.projection: Exact Euclidean capped L2 energy projection in FP64 via sorted breakpoints; retain moments afterward.

constraint.projection: y_l=min(cap_l,theta||x_l||)*x_l/||x_l||. x_l=0->0 without division. theta=1 if locally-clipped energy feasible; otherwise exact common theta <=1 from sorted breakpoints. No sequential ad-hoc radial/clamp substitute.
constraint.stored_feasibility: On FP32 stored R compute FP64 local excess max(||R_l||-cap_l,0) and global radius excess max(sqrt(sum||R_l||²)-rho,0), each <=1e-6. Also report raw squared-energy excess with units; do not normalize/change criterion after results. No hidden shrink.

controller.zero: initial F<.05 forward-only/R0/update0, reenter once F>=.05
controller.normal: Before each nonterminal update, if own t>=12 and currentF>=.05 and e<4 expand one step. Satisfied active requests keep updating at fixedradius; radius never decreases.
controller.terminal: k=24 or all requests remain inactive/satisfied. Last evaluated candidate only; no terminal backward/update/expansion.

commit.payload: exact terminalBUILD FP32 weights, no new solve/reconstruction/doubleadd
commit.H: After all eligible writes final rewrite-only native mean keys append once per eligible layer including zero and unsatisfied requests; KL excluded. Reuse terminal keys only qualified parity.
commit.transaction: RAM W/H/RNG/cache/context/cursor rollback on technical error; no partialcommit
commit.next_batch: own preceding committed model andH; recreate teacher/anchor/geometry/firstP and reset optimizer/radius

limits.side_observer_diagnostic_cost: separate explicitly metered not hidden in25fitbudget
